milestones.title: ChatGPT launches
milestones.detail: General-purpose LLMs reach the public; the AI era of this story starts here.

milestones.title: An AI tops the HackerOne US leaderboard
milestones.detail: XBOW, an autonomous pentesting system, ranks first in the US after about 1,060 submitted reports in a few months.

milestones.title: Big Sleep stops an exploit before it ships
milestones.detail: Google's Big Sleep agent finds SQLite flaw CVE-2025-6965, known to attackers but not yet exploited, and it is patched first.

milestones.title: Big Sleep reports its first 20 bugs
milestones.detail: Twenty vulnerabilities in open source projects such as FFmpeg and ImageMagick, found and reproduced by the agent.

milestones.title: DARPA AIxCC finals
milestones.detail: Autonomous systems find 54 of 63 planted bugs in 54 million lines of code, patch 43, and uncover 18 real vulnerabilities.

milestones.title: First reported AI-orchestrated espionage campaign
milestones.detail: Anthropic says a state-backed group used Claude Code to run 80 to 90 percent of an intrusion campaign against about 30 targets.

milestones.title: 90 zero-days exploited in 2025
milestones.detail: Google counts 90 zero-days used in the wild in 2025, almost half against enterprise products, and expects AI to speed up discovery.

milestones.title: AI scams enter the FBI ledger
milestones.detail: The FBI's 2025 report lists nearly $893 million in losses tied to AI-enabled scams, out of $20.9 billion overall.

milestones.title: Exploits become the top way in
milestones.detail: Verizon's 2026 DBIR: exploitation of vulnerabilities is the first step in 31% of breaches, overtaking stolen credentials.

milestones.title: Project Glasswing: 10,000 serious bugs in a month
milestones.detail: About 50 partners using Claude Mythos Preview report over 10,000 high or critical vulnerabilities; 23,019 candidates flagged in open source.

milestones.title: One in four breaches is AI-enabled
milestones.detail: IBM's 2026 study: AI-driven attacks behind 1 in 4 malicious breaches; global average breach cost hits a record $4.99 million.
